name: stretchgoals-person-receive-stretch
display_name: stretchGoals: Person may RECEIVE a Stretch
description: A person may receive a stretch unless one of their conditions BLOCKS it or needs ASK_FIRST. Once a clinician clears them, that condition is stored as CLEARED_CONDITION instead of HAS_CONDITION, so ASK_FIRST no longer applies. Rules and sources: indykite/rules.js.
note: IndyKite's Cypher does not accept EXISTS { } subqueries (validator: 'invalid cypher syntax'), so this uses pattern predicates. Created in the Hub on 24 Oct 2026 and switched to Active.
